**Job Title:** Talent Acquisition Specialist

**Company:** www.masind.net

**Location:** Juinagar, Navi Mumbai

**Experience:** Fresher to 1 year of Recruitment

**Department: Human Resource**

**Job Description:**  
We are seeking a motivated **Talent Acquisition Specialist** to join our dynamic team. The HR Recruiter will be responsible for sourcing, screening, and interviewing candidates for various positions within the company. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, a strong ability to multitask, and a keen eye for identifying top talent. This role will play a crucial part in ensuring our organization attracts and hires the best candidates to meet our staffing needs.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Source potential candidates through online channels (e.g., Job portals, social platforms and professional networks).
* Screen resumes and job applications.
* Conduct interviews using various reliable recruiting and selection tools/methods to filter candidates.
* Assess applicants’ relevant knowledge, skills, soft skills, experience, and aptitudes.
* Onboard new employees in order to become fully integrated.
* Share **offer letters, salary annexures, and other pre-joining documents** with selected candidates.
* Follow up with selected candidates regarding **offer acceptance, documentation, and joining confirmation**.
* Provide **pre-onboarding support** and ensure candidates are informed about joining formalities, required documents, reporting time, and other relevant details.
* Maintain regular communication with candidates during the **notice period / pre-joining stage** to ensure smooth onboarding.
* Develop and maintain relationships with **colleges and universities** for campus recruitment.
* Prepare **daily, weekly, and monthly recruitment reports**.
* Monitor and apply HR recruiting best practices.

**Requirements:**

* **Bachelor's Degree** & Freshers are most welcome
* Fresher to 1 year of relevant end to end recruitment experience
* Familiarity with Job portals and resume databases.
* Experience with sourcing techniques.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* A keen understanding of the differences between various roles within organizations.

title: Manager II, Engineering
description:
**About the Role**  
  
As an Engineering Manager at Uber, you will lead a team of engineers and engineering managers in the development of global solutions, collaborating closely with product managers, data scientists, and other engineering teams.  
  
This role, within the Bangalore-based Payments organization (Disbursements Processing), entails leading, mentoring, and managing a high-performing, diverse team. This organization aims to leverage Payments as a competitive advantage by optimizing the paying and payment processes for both users and the business.  
  
The Disbursements Processing team manages global earner payouts, encompassing the following responsibilities:  

* Collaboration with over 20+ global external partners to facilitate worldwide earner payments.
* Ensuring a reliable and consistent payout experience.
* Developing and managing a scalable engineering platform with continuous enhancements.
* Guaranteeing reliable weekly payments for 10 million earners globally.

  
- What the Candidate Will Do -  
Lead a 10-person engineering team and be responsible for:  

* Ideating, developing, and delivering payment product platforms.
* Operational and engineering excellence initiatives.
* Career growth within the organization by developing Staff-level individual contributors.
* Creating organizational and cross-organizational impact by designing, iterating on, and delivering processes that support Uber engineering.
* Partnering with diverse roles and individuals across various disciplines such as product management, talent acquisition, data science, and product design, spanning from fresh graduates to experienced professionals.

  
- Basic Qualifications -  

* Experience in engineering management (4+ years), demonstrating the ability to manage a larger team
* Skilled in guiding, mentoring, and coaching technically proficient teams, leveraging technical expertise and analytical abilities. Able to architect and design robust, high-scale systems, encouraging engineers to think broadly and generically in their solutions.
* Knowledgeable in large-scale distributed systems, SQL/NoSQL storage, cloud services (AWS, GCP, OCI), transactional updates, asynchronous processing (Kafka), logging, monitoring, observability, and performance tuning.
* Experienced in working with globally distributed, cross-functional teams, coordinating efforts to deliver multi-area solutions.
* Proficient in cross-functional collaboration, influencing PMs, designers, data scientists, and upstream business/infrastructure teams to identify, prioritize, and solve problems.
* Proven ability to grow teams, recruit/retain strong engineering leaders, and manage performance.
* Familiar with client-side architecture for large native mobile and web platform teams, covering dependency management, feature flagging, UI trade-offs, and funnel design.
* Adaptable to a strong, reliability-focused engineering culture while prioritizing business stakeholder value. Possesses self-learning capabilities, strong time management for scaling, precise communication, and strong collaborative traits.

  
- Preferred Qualifications -  

* Experience with payments, including understanding global and regional nuances.
* Proven ability to execute complex initiatives, delivering resilient, high-performing systems on time and meeting business goals and user needs.
* Background in product experimentation, including statistical knowledge, experimentation mechanics, and analysis skills to interpret, debug, and challenge experimental results.

  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

### **Description**

The candidate will provide technical support for Infor customers using the Infor POS solution. This role requires flexibility to work in shifts, including India night hours, and weekends as needed. Strong technical aptitude, excellent English communication skills, effective teamwork, and a customer‑focused mindset are essential. As an Infor POS Technical Support Analyst, the candidate will be expected to learn and support Infor’s POS software and hardware ecosystem. The role involves delivering high‑quality remote support to customers across Canada, the Americas, and Europe. Proficiency in both written and verbal English is required. The position typically reports to a manager or team lead.

### **A Typical Day in the Life Includes:**

An Infor POS Technical Analyst is expected to transition efficiently into live support for escalated technical issues upon completion of product training. The role requires delivering consistent, high‑quality remote assistance in accordance with established departmental procedures. Analysts are responsible for maintaining and expanding their technical product expertise and are expected to drive every customer case through to full resolution while adhering to all policies and workflows. Our customer base is primarily located in Canada and the United States. Analysts must communicate confidently and clearly in English, translating complex technical concepts into language customers can easily understand. As the Infor POS team operates 24/7, analysts must be flexible and able to support all shift requirements, including weekends as business needs dictate.  
  
The team operates within a goal‑driven environment. Monthly individual and team objectives are established, and all analysts are expected to consistently meet or exceed these performance targets.

### **Basic Qualifications:**

1. Experience range: 2-4 years’ work experience in hotel industry Front Desk or F & B Service departments, preferably F & B service.  
2. Technical skills: operational expertise on hotel operating software systems (Property Management Systems/PMS or Point Of Sale Systems/POS) and proficiency in basic Microsoft applications (Word, PowerPoint, Excel) is a must. Additional knowledge of computer applications, SQL certification etc. is a plus.  
3. Linguistical abilities: Proficiency in the English language & customer service skills.  
4. Academic qualifications: IHM, IIHM, BHM or equivalent degrees.  
5. Work hours & shifts: willing to work during India night hours, and weekends.

Technical skills in PC troubleshooting to include Windows desktop operating systems (Windows 7/10/11), TCP/IP networking, including troubleshooting using O/S command line utilities, DHCP vs fixed IP addresses, and IP networks/subnet masks, knowledge of peripherals devices including receipt printers, barcode scanners, credit card terminals, and the ability to understand SQL databases and queries.

7. Candidates’ work experience should be with a reputable hotel group (Taj, Oberoi, Sheraton, ITC, Ramada, Accor, Marriott, Hyatt, The Leela and similar).

1. Previous experience with Point of Sale, restaurant, or hospitality work environments.

description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

Job Description

**About the Role**

The Cloud ERP Platform Expert is responsible for the implementation, operation, and continuous evolution of Haleon’s global ERP platform across SAP RISE, SAP BTP, Azure, PaaS, and SaaS ecosystems. The role ensures that the ERP estate is secure, resilient, compliant, and highly available, enabling critical business operations and transformation initiatives.

Working across the full ERP technology stack - Applications, SAP Basis, Databases, Operating Systems, Cloud Infrastructure, and Security - the individual will lead platform governance, operational excellence, modernization, vulnerability management, and lifecycle management while partnering with internal teams and strategic service providers.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for end-to-end implementation and operation of Haleon’s ERP platforms across SAP RISE, BTP, Azure, and hybrid landscapes.
* Execute Haleon’s SAP BTP strategy, governance, and adoption roadmap, including services such as Integration Suite, HANA Cloud, Build, Signavio, Event Mesh, and Cloud ALM.
* Lead SAP Basis, BTP, database (Oracle/HANA), OS, and infrastructure administration activities for a large-scale global ERP estate.
* Ensure platform availability, performance, capacity, security, and disaster recovery readiness.
* Drive platform patching, upgrade, migration, and refresh activities.
* Lead vulnerability remediation and security hardening across the ERP technical stack.
* Ensure compliance with SOX, ITGC, audit, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements from ERP platform standpoint.
* Govern change, release, incident, and problem management processes for ERP landscape.
* Manage partners and service providers to deliver operational excellence.
* Act as escalation point for critical production and business-impacting incidents.

**Required Experience & Skills**

**Technical Expertise**

* SAP ECC, S/4HANA (RISE), BW/BW4HANA, APO, PI/PO, Solution Manager, GRC, MDG, ILM, PLM, BFC, FIM, BODS, ATTP, and SAP Java Stack platforms.
* SAP BTP administration, governance, security, and operations.
* Azure cloud hosting and hybrid ERP architectures.
* Oracle and SAP HANA database administration and performance tuning.
* Integration with enterprise platforms including Celonis, OpenText, Loftware, Salesforce, Ariba, Concur, Fieldglass, and IBP.

**Professional Experience**

* 10+ years of Proven experience managing **large global ERP estates (100+ instances)** .
* Strong background in SAP cloud transformations, ERP migrations, and platform modernization programs.
* Expertise in ERP security, resilience, compliance, and operational governance.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams and managed service providers.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.
* Proven ability to manage complex escalations and influence Director, VP, and senior leadership stakeholders.
* Experience within pharmaceutical or other regulated industries preferred.

**Success in This Role**

Implement and operate a **secure, resilient, compliant, and future-ready ERP platform** that accelerates business value, enables cloud transformation, and ensures reliable operations across Haleon’s global ERP landscape.

**Job Posting End Date**

2026-11-09

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**The Experience**  
  
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword — it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
Who We Are and Where We're Going
  
  
Assurance at Salesforce is being rebuilt as an engineering discipline.
  
  
Legacy GRC runs on spreadsheets, screenshots, and an annual scramble to prove that controls worked months ago. We're replacing that model with one that is continuous, automated, and built into how Salesforce ships. Controls are code. Evidence comes from pipelines, not people chasing tickets. We work to improve the state of controls, drive decisions with risk, govern with code, and make compliance a streamlined business process.
  
  
Our strategy:

* Risk-informed, control managed. We monitor, validate, and improve the security controls that stand against threats and failures. This proves trust while delivering risk operations, compliance artifacts, and outputs, and it opens access to new markets through the product we build and the behavior we change.
* Visibility and invention. We give Salesforce a clear, current view of its security posture. We equip the Assurance team with a new way of protecting Salesforce, through the invention we create together. We also invest in the people who work here, with room to grow, take on new challenges, and drive excellence.
Always in front. We turn gaps into signals, alerts, and escalations. When a control fails, it flows into a workflow built to help stakeholders meet their trust obligations. Nothing waits for the next audit to surface.  

We're hiring people who want to build this future. You'll have real ownership, a real roadmap, and the chance to define what modern assurance looks like for the industry.
  
  
How We Work

* Engineering-first culture. We use version control, code review, CI/CD, and backlogs. Assurance work ships like software.
* Automate first. If it's done manually twice, it's a candidate for a build.
* Signals, not surprises. Gaps become alerts and workflows, and control failures resolve through defined escalation paths.
* Embedded partners. We work alongside T&P teams and solve problems with them, not at them.
* Outcomes over activity. We measure risk reduced, effort saved, and audit friction removed.
Room to grow. Learn the engineering side if you come from GRC, or the risk side if you come from engineering. We support both paths.  

As an Information Security Senior Associate, Vendor Risk & Security, your job responsibilities will include:
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Triage and track Third-Party Security Assessment (TPSA/TPSD) cases in ProcessUnity from intake to closure, including supplier follow-up questions.
* Do first-pass review of supplier questionnaire responses against a documented rubric, and escalate exceptions to the senior reviewer.
* Support subprocessor security reviews with documentation review and status tracking. Several of these run at once, and some are tied to go-live or code-freeze dates.
* Collect and organize evidence for audit readiness
* Maintain intake hygiene in ProcessUnity: bulk imports of new supplier TPSAs, templates and intake fields for new supplier categories, and consistency across cases.
* Chase outstanding evidence and documentation from vendors and internal stakeholders.
Help with adjacent vendor compliance work, such as BPO questionnaire follow-ups and security-training content.  

**You're Our Person If...**

* Interest in third-party risk, vendor security, or security compliance. A security background is helpful but not required.
* Strong written communication. You will send many follow-ups and need to state exactly what is missing.
* Attention to detail when reading questionnaire answers line by line.
* Ability to manage many open cases and deadlines without dropping follow-ups.
* Willingness to escalate when an answer looks wrong or incomplete.
* Experience with a GRC or case-management tool (ProcessUnity or similar).
* Familiarity with security questionnaires or frameworks (SIG, CAIQ, SOC 2, ISO 27001).
* Prior audit-support or compliance-coordination experience.

**Key Expectations**

* Execute ongoing operations tasks with high ownership and accountability.
* Identify operational inefficiencies and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure accurate and timely resolution of participant and plan administration issues.
* Deliver work in line with client SLAs and quality standards.

The Solutions Delivery Analyst is also responsible for creating and maintaining robust documentation and SOPs, supporting transitions between Operations and Shared Services, and delivering client specific operational training. **Shift :US Shift / Night Shift**

**Experience :** 7–8 Years in US Staffing Operations

**Employment Type : Full-Time**

**Role Summary**

We are seeking an experienced and result-driven US Staffing Business Operations Manager to oversee and optimize end-to-end staffing operations for our US recruitment business. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving operational excellence across recruitment delivery, bench sales, client management, business development support, compliance, and process improvement initiatives.

This role requires strong leadership, operational management, stakeholder coordination, and performance monitoring skills to ensure business objectives, client expectations, and revenue targets are consistently achieved.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Recruitment Delivery Management**

* Monitor recruitment teams to ensure timely and quality candidate submissions.
* Track and improve fill rates, time-to-fill, and offer-to-join ratios.
* Ensure recruiters meet productivity and delivery targets.
* Drive continuous improvement in sourcing and screening processes.
* Collaborate with account managers and delivery teams to fulfill client requirements.

**Bench Sales & Consultant Deployment**

* Monitor bench consultant utilization and deployment activities.
* Ensure active marketing of available consultants to clients and vendor networks.
* Reduce bench aging and improve consultant placement rates.
* Track consultant revenue generation and deployment timelines.
* Coordinate with recruiters and sales teams to maximize consultant utilization.

**Client Relationship Management**

* Maintain strong relationships with existing clients and staffing partners.
* Monitor client satisfaction and service delivery metrics.
* Resolve escalations and ensure timely response to client requests.
* Improve client retention and repeat business opportunities.
* Conduct periodic business reviews with key accounts.

**Business Development Support**

* Support sales and account management teams in client acquisition initiatives.
* Track meetings, proposals, opportunities, and conversion metrics.
* Assist in identifying new business opportunities and market expansion strategies.
* Monitor revenue contribution from new and existing accounts.
* Coordinate between delivery and sales teams for successful client onboarding.

**Operations & Process Excellence**

* Establish and monitor staffing operational processes and SLAs.
* Analyze recruiter productivity and operational efficiency metrics.
* Identify bottlenecks and implement process improvements.
* Prepare operational dashboards, reports, and performance reviews.
* Ensure optimal utilization of ATS, CRM, VMS, and reporting systems.

**Compliance & Risk Management**

* Ensure compliance with US staffing regulations and client requirements.
* Monitor onboarding documentation, I-9 compliance, and audit readiness.
* Maintain accuracy of consultant records and employment documentation.
* Minimize compliance errors and operational risks.
* Support internal and external audits as required.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree or MBA preferred.
* 7+ years of experience in US Staffing Operations, Delivery Management, or Business Operations.
* Strong understanding of US Staffing lifecycle, VMS, MSP, Direct Clients, W2, C2C, and 1099 hiring models.
* Experience managing recruitment, bench sales, and client operations teams.
* Knowledge of US employment compliance, onboarding, and documentation processes.
* Strong analytical, reporting, and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent communication and leadership abilities.
* Experience with ATS, CRM, VMS tools, and reporting dashboards.

Pay: From ₹70,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. In this role, you will hold end-to-end technical ownership over the platform’s core engines—including policy as code, compliance as code, automated evidence collection, telemetry and alerting, and risk evaluation modules.
  
  
Beyond hands-on development in Python, Java, and modern front-end frameworks, you will act as a primary technical leader: defining system architecture, scoping and planning multi-quarter technical initiatives, and guiding distributed feature teams from concept through deployment. You will also pioneer the team’s operational strategy around AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) to accelerate output and elevate code quality across the engineering organization.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* End-to-End Ownership: Take technical ownership of complex, multi-system initiatives, driving architectural decisions, technical specifications, phase planning, and execution across the delivery lifecycle.
* Architecture & System Design: Architect resilient, cloud-native microservice architectures that process large-scale compliance telemetry, support automated evidence ingestion, and execute low-latency risk evaluation engines.

* Technical Governance: Establish engineering standards, perform high-impact code and architecture reviews, enforce secure coding guidelines, and institute rigorous CI/CD and testing benchmarks across the engineering org.

* Automated Evidence Collection: Lead the design of automated evidence collection pipelines integrating with multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), identity providers, enterprise security tools, CI/CD pipelines, ticketing systems, and productivity / corporate applications (Workday, Netsuite, etc).
* Risk & Regulatory Modeling: Build dynamic risk analysis engines and auditing interfaces capable of mapping continuous technical evidence against major regulatory standards (NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2).
* AI-Assisted Engineering: Lead the adoption and integration of AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Gemini, OpenAI APIs) across the engineering lifecycle to optimize team productivity, automate test generation, and streamline refactoring.
* Mentorship: Actively mentor senior and mid-level engineers across time zones, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning.
Lead cross-functional alignment and technical discussions across a geographically dispersed team operating in an asynchronous-first culture.  

**You're Our Person If...**

* Experience: 6–13 years of professional full-stack software engineering experience, including 3+ years at the Senior Member of Technical Staff (SMTS) or Lead Member of Technical Staff (LMTS) level leading technical projects and distributed engineering teams.
* Project Ownership Track Record: Proven experience taking complex SaaS platforms or enterprise software projects from architectural inception to production delivery.
